The '''Zaddja system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaddja/Legends|Zaddja]].<ref name="CE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' featured a moon named [[Zadd]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Directive 7}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' placed the moon in the same galactic grid square than the Zaddja system.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Considering this placement and the similarity in the names, [[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and subsequent [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|system appendixes]], stated that Zadd was located in the Zaddja system.<ref name="Fry" />
